"use client";

import { BarChart } from '@mantine/charts';

import { mixedStackData, mixedStackDataCode } from '@/components/rendyn-libraries/mantine/upstream/src/demos/charts/BarChart/_data';

function Demo() {
  return (
    <BarChart
      h={300}
      data={mixedStackData}
      dataKey="month"
      series={[
        { name: 'Smartphones', color: 'url(#crosshatch)', stackId: 'a' },
        { name: 'Laptops', color: 'blue.6', stackId: 'b' },
        { name: 'Tablets', color: 'url(#diagonalStripes)', stackId: 'b' },
      ]}
    >
      <defs>
        <pattern
          id="diagonalStripes"
          patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
          width={6}
          height={8}
          patternTransform="rotate(45)"
        >
          <rect
            width="2"
            height="8"
            transform="translate(0,0)"
            fill="color-mix(in lch, var(--mantine-color-teal-6) 70%, rgba(0,0,0,0))"
          />
        </pattern>

        <pattern id="crosshatch" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" width={8} height={8}>
          <path
            d="M 0 0 L 8 0 L 8 8 L 0 8 Z"
            fill="none"
            stroke="color-mix(in lch, var(--mantine-color-indigo-6) 70%, rgba(0,0,0,0))"
            strokeWidth="1"
          />
          <path
            d="M 0 0 L 8 8"
            stroke="color-mix(in lch, var(--mantine-color-indigo-6) 70%, rgba(0,0,0,0))"
            strokeWidth="1"
          />
          <path
            d="M 8 0 L 0 8"
            stroke="color-mix(in lch, var(--mantine-color-indigo-6) 70%, rgba(0,0,0,0))"
            strokeWidth="1"
          />
        </pattern>
      </defs>
    </BarChart>
  );
}
const RendynExampleComponent = Demo;
export function RendynExample() { return <RendynExampleComponent  />; }

# Mantine bar chart

35 published Mantine bar chart examples with complete pinned source and MIT attribution.

## Installation

- Complete MIT usage examples extracted from the upstream demo code template; documentation configurator machinery is excluded.
- Mount MantineProvider once at your client application root and import @mantine/core/styles.css. The returned preview wrapper is a standalone example; reuse an existing provider when integrating.

- Copy every returned file and preserve the MIT licence notice.
- Render the returned preview.tsx example, or integrate the example into your existing provider.
